neighbours.label: the start of a small number stating a rate or odds (just 0.4%, 1 in 14 million)
fire: The trial found a risk of serious side effects of just 0.2% among adults.
Statisticians put the chance of a fluke at roughly 1 in 3 million.
The bank lowered its annual charge to a mere 0.35% of assets.
Scientists said there was only a 2-in-a-million chance the signal was noise.
Over the decade the death rate fell to 0.6% of all cases.
The odds of being struck by lightning are about 1 in 500,000.
The platform takes a commission of only 0.9% on each trade.
Engineers estimated the failure probability at 0.01% per launch.
quiet: The trial found a risk of serious side effects was very small among adults.
Statisticians put the chance of a fluke at almost nothing.
The bank lowered its annual charge to a modest flat fee.
Scientists said there was only a slim chance the signal was noise.
Over the decade the death rate fell to a record low.
The odds of being struck by lightning are extremely long.
The platform takes a small commission on each trade.
Engineers estimated the failure probability as negligible per launch.

notes: Card: peaks on ' ' / digits / ' one' right before tiny probabilities and fees. Probe: '1 in 14 million' 0.49, '0.4%' 0.56, '1.8%' 0.23, '5 percent' 0.08, worded versions ~0.05-0.15.
